description: A PHP script for viewing and managing code trackers within the TestLink open source project. It initializes the page, retrieves tracker data, and handles user permissions.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: A class managing code tracker data, instantiated as $codeTrackerMgr.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used for rendering the page.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument object for page handling, including user session data and request parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view or manage code trackers.
